image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a white baby bib with a green tropical leaf pattern. The bib features a rounded shield shape with a curved neck opening trimmed in white lace or crochet edging. White fabric ties extend from the sides of the neck area. The material appears to be a soft fabric, possibly cotton or a blend, with a matte finish. The background is a dark, out-of-focus wooden surface.

Some leaf edges show minor blurring or irregularity that doesn't perfectly follow the fabric's subtle wrinkles, suggesting a potential AI generation artifact in the texture mapping.

The tie on the left side seems to emerge from the lace trim without a clear, structurally sound attachment point to the main bib body. It appears to float slightly or merge ambiguously with the edging, lacking a defined seam or anchor.
